title: Scheme of Evaluation – Foundational Stage
subtitle: Joy of Learning (Pre Primary and Classes I & II)
overview: Assessment is a part of the teaching-learning process. Assessment and Evaluation will be continuous and comprehensive as per the New Education Policy 'NEP-2020' and National Curriculum Framework - Foundational Stage. It involves the systematic gathering of information from different sources regarding children's learning. In a 'Competency-based curriculum' as proposed by NCF, evidences of the learning achievements of children is gathered and documented through observations of the child and analysing artefacts.

areas.detail: Listening, speaking, reading, writing and enrichment of vocabulary

tools: Portfolio samples (artwork, Joy of Learning worksheets)
assessmentNote: In accordance with NEP-2020 and CBSE guidelines, the school follows continuous and holistic assessment with no formal examinations. Children's progress is monitored through activities and observations. Parent Teacher Interactions are conducted four times a year, and Holistic Progress Cards are issued annually.

scholasticGrades.title: Grade Sheet – Scholastic Area (Joy of Learning)

holisticProgressCard: Holistic Progress Card is a 360-degree, multidimensional report of progress, that reflects the progress as well as the uniqueness of each learner in the cognitive, affective, emotional, and psychomotor domains. It is a shift in assessment from one that is primarily testing rote memorization skills, to one that is more regular and formatively competency-based. It promotes learning and development for children, and evaluates higher-order skills, such as analysis, critical thinking, and conceptual clarity.
